subject: Halcyon procurement: tenancy commitment matrix and private vs dedicated sizing
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Halcyon tenancy scenarios + ask for procurement walk-through

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, I attached a compact "tenancy commitment matrix" that maps your three pilot workloads (triage, chart ingestion, and clinician assistant) to recommended hosting modes and GPU slate. The key trade-offs are summarized on page 1, but high-level:

- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): best predictable latency for high-concurrency triage and clinician assistant; requires monthly commit for capacity blocks.
- Private (VPC/air-gapped option): recommended for chart ingestion and PHI-heavy test tooling; higher upfront provisioning and ops coordination but removes multi-tenant surface.

The attached workbook includes two capacity scenarios: a conservative 3-month pilot and an accelerated 12-week ramp. For quick reference:

- Conservative pilot: 4x A100-80GB equivalent tiles reserved (expected 180 QPS burst capacity via autoscale), estimated committed monthly spend: $120k.
- Ramp pilot (12 weeks): 8x A100-80GB equivalent tiles reserved, plus 2x on-demand burst tiles, estimated month 1 effective spend: $210k.

Could you confirm the procurement path you want us to follow (PO vs DocuSign + SOW), and whether your security team still requires an air-gapped on-prem evaluation before we proceed with a Private deployment? If so, we can loop in our Private deployment engineering lead (cc'd).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm procurement preference and any internal approval windows.
2) We lock the pilot matrix (attached) and provide a final pricing appendix for signature.
3) If Private/air-gap is required, schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra/security team and our SRE.

Attachments: halcyon_tenancy_matrix_v1.xlsx; private-vs-dedicated-cost-breakdown.pdf

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0149
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

From: Halcyon Procurement <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice@halcyonhealth.com>, Dan Park <dan.park@cloudvendor.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Halcyon tenancy scenarios + ask for procurement walk-through

Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the workbook. A couple of clarifying items from procurement/security before we pull legal: 

1) For the Private option: can you confirm approximate lead time (procurement -> infra ready) for an air-gapped appliance deployment? Our security team will need a calendar estimate to plan their change window.
2) For Dedicated: can you confirm the SLA you can include around percent of requests served under 150ms p95 for the clinician assistant workload? That is a gating KPI for us.
3) Pricing: procurement prefers a monthly PO with net-45. Are there standard discount tiers tied to a 12-month commit?

We can do a procurement walkthrough on Tuesday; please include your technical lead if possible.

Regards,
Halcyon Procurement
procurement@halcyonhealth.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Halcyon Procurement <procurement@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice@halcyonhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Sep 2028 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Halcyon tenancy scenarios + ask for procurement walk-through

Hi —

Answers inline: 

1) Private appliance lead time: typical calendar is 8–10 weeks after contract signature for an air-gapped on-prem package (includes HW procurement if you choose that path). We can expedite to ~6 weeks if Halcyon leverages an existing cloud provider partner for staging and we limit initial ingestion to a subset of charts.

2) Dedicated SLA: we can commit to 150ms p95 for single-turn clinician assistant prompts under the 8x-A100 reserved configuration, with an SLA credit ladder in the contract. This assumes the canonical prompt length distribution in the matrix and that you pin the clinician assistant to the reserved pool. The SLA also prescribes graceful fallback to a compatible model variant if capacity saturates.

3) Discounts: yes — standard tiering: 10% off list for 12-month commit at the pilot slate; 18% for a 24-month commit. I attached a brief pricing appendix in the PDF. Net-45 is acceptable under our enterprise payment terms; we will need a PO referenced on invoices.

Action items from our side: Marissa will draft the pricing appendix and the SOW, Karthik will prepare a tech slide for the security call, and Michael (ops) will provide a deployment-runbook excerpt if you want to review on the call.

Proposed time for walkthrough: Tue, 5 Sep, 10:00am PT. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite and include Dan Park (our cloud partner) for the lead-time discussion.

Thanks,
Naomi

Quick note from the partner side: if Halcyon elects for a hybrid path (Private for ingestion + Dedicated for inference), we can front-load hardware staging in our secure staging facility to shave ~2 weeks off lead time. There is a small staging fee (~$8k) but it reduces procurement friction for cert windows.

Also suggesting a narrow canary approach: begin with a 2-node private appliance for ingestion to validate PHI chain-of-custody, then flip ingestion traffic to private while inference runs on a dedicated reserved pool. That reduces initial CAPEX and gives you end-to-end evidence for security audits.

Happy to talk through the staging and logistics on Tue 10am PT.

—Dan

Thanks everyone — great sync today. Summary and immediate asks: 

1) Halcyon confirmed PO + net-45 procurement cadence; procurement to share PO template by EOD 9/6.
2) Agreed pilot path: Hybrid (2-node Private appliance for ingestion + 6x reserved A100-80GB equivalent for Dedicated inference). We agreed on a 6-week expedited lead time (partner staging + parallel legal) for pilot hardware.
3) Pricing & commit: Halcyon will sign a 12-month pilot commitment for the reserved tiles. Marissa to circulate a pricing appendix and SOW by 9/7; Halcyon to review and return with redlines.
4) SLA: Redwood to include 150ms p95 SLA for clinician assistant pinned to the reserved pool; initial SLA draft will include credit ladder (Marissa to include in SOW).

Attachments shared post-call: SLA-exceptions_draft.docx (marked with the agreed canary wording), updated tenancy worksheet (halcyon_tenancy_matrix_v1.xlsx - v2 to follow), pricing appendix draft.

Next steps: Marissa will send the DocuSign pricing appendix + SOW draft; procurement to provide a PO template; legal/rev to handle standard redlines.

If there are any outstanding technical asks (runbook, encryption/HSM specifics), Michael will post the runbook excerpt to the shared Drive by EOD 9/6.

Best,
Naomi
